title: Diamonds are a girls best friend!
text: Diamonds are a girls best friend!. I am super happy with these diamonds they look exactly like the picture, no even better, they are big and they came in really fast I have recently lost some similar diamonds I had for decoration and I was struggling to find something similar on Amazon to be honest nothing this size in particular and nothing good quality because they are plastic and the size apparently is not so popular I don't really like the smaller version of these so I am ultra happy they arrived really fast and in good condition, the only thing that was heavy was the bag that came with them but other than that they are just perfect! I will use these asap! Thank you!

product_metadata.title: 2 Pounds of 25 Carat Clear Acrylic Diamonds - Big Diamonds for Table Centerpiece Decorations, Wedding Decorations, Bridal Shower Decorations
features: Complete set of 2 pounds of 25 carat clear acrylic diamonds, a centerpiece table scatter that is sure to impress any guest at your next event.
These diamond decor gems reflect light beautifully and adds the perfect finishing touch as a vase filler or table decor.
Whether it's a birthday party, bridal shower, wedding, or baby shower, these clear acrylic crystal diamonds are the perfect decoration for any royalty themed event.
Also perfect for arts & crafts project for you and your children! Make a stunning floral arrangement or fairy tale style collage, these diamonds are the perfect DIY essential to add to your kit!
Each order comes in a 2 pound bag containing 120 pieces. Acrylic diamond gems measure at approximately 1.25" x 0.75" (32mm x 20mm).
